Sandbox_BeltRadio_MPBubble_tooltip: Multiplayer: a line received by a walkie-talkie hooked on the belt is also shown in a radio bubble above the player, as for a walkie-talkie in hand. Off: the line only appears in the radio chat (vanilla).
Sandbox_BeltRadio_BeltBattery_tooltip: A switched-on walkie-talkie hooked on the belt uses its battery every minute, as in hand. Off: the charge stays frozen at the belt and the drain is caught up when the walkie-talkie is taken in hand again (vanilla).
Sandbox_BeltRadio_BeltListening_tooltip: Singleplayer: a switched-on walkie-talkie hooked on the belt hears the station it is tuned to. Off: only a walkie-talkie in hand or a radio on the back hears anything (vanilla). A radio stored in the inventory never hears anything in singleplayer.
Sandbox_BeltRadio_BeltNoise: Noise of a walkie-talkie at the belt
Sandbox_BeltRadio_BeltNoise_tooltip: A switched-on walkie-talkie hooked on the belt makes a noise that attracts zombies each time it receives a line, as in hand (same volume and range, none with headphones). Off: it only makes noise for the first line received (vanilla).
Sandbox_BeltRadio_BeltAudio: Sound of a walkie-talkie at the belt
Sandbox_BeltRadio_BeltAudio_tooltip: A switched-on walkie-talkie hooked on the belt plays the radio sound as in hand: static while it waits, then the broadcast sound (emergency broadcast or program) for each line received. Only you hear it, as in hand. Off: no sound at the belt (vanilla).
Sandbox_BeltRadio_MainsRechargeHours_too: In-game hours for a radio adapted for mains power to recharge an empty battery in an electrified area (generator, or grid power inside a building). The battery must be in the radio; on mains power it no longer drains.
